# A32 corpus for GNU as, which checks what llvm-mc's own corpus cannot:
# the instructions the security, virtualization and divide extensions add,
# the banked registers of `msr` and `mrs`, and the shifted operands, whose
# amount llvm-mc wants a `#` on that this assembler's GAS-dialect lexer eats
# as a comment.
#
# GNU as runs with `-march=armv7ve`; see run.sh.

# ---- the load/store exclusives ----
ldrex r0, [r1]
ldrexb r2, [r3]
ldrexh r4, [r5]
ldrexd r6, r7, [r8]
ldrexd r6, [r8]
strex r0, r1, [r2]
strexb r3, r4, [r5]
strexh r6, r7, [r8]
strexd r0, r2, r3, [r4]
strexd r0, r2, [r4]
clrex
swp r0, r1, [r2]
swpb r3, r4, [r5]

# ---- saturating and packing ----
ssat r0, 1, r1
ssat r0, 32, r1
ssat16 r0, 1, r1
ssat16 r0, 16, r1
usat r0, 0, r1
usat r0, 31, r1
usat16 r0, 0, r1
usat16 r0, 15, r1
pkhbt r0, r1, r2
pkhtb r0, r1, r2
qadd r0, r1, r2
qdadd r3, r4, r5
qsub r6, r7, r8
qdsub r9, r10, r11

# ---- parallel arithmetic ----
sadd8 r0, r1, r2
sadd16 r0, r1, r2
sasx r0, r1, r2
ssax r0, r1, r2
ssub8 r0, r1, r2
ssub16 r0, r1, r2
qadd8 r0, r1, r2
qadd16 r0, r1, r2
qasx r0, r1, r2
qsax r0, r1, r2
qsub8 r0, r1, r2
qsub16 r0, r1, r2
shadd8 r0, r1, r2
shadd16 r0, r1, r2
shasx r0, r1, r2
shsax r0, r1, r2
shsub8 r0, r1, r2
shsub16 r0, r1, r2
uadd8 r0, r1, r2
uadd16 r0, r1, r2
uasx r0, r1, r2
usax r0, r1, r2
usub8 r0, r1, r2
usub16 r0, r1, r2
uqadd8 r0, r1, r2
uqadd16 r0, r1, r2
uqasx r0, r1, r2
uqsax r0, r1, r2
uqsub8 r0, r1, r2
uqsub16 r0, r1, r2
uhadd8 r0, r1, r2
uhadd16 r0, r1, r2
uhasx r0, r1, r2
uhsax r0, r1, r2
uhsub8 r0, r1, r2
uhsub16 r0, r1, r2
sel r0, r1, r2
usad8 r0, r1, r2
usada8 r0, r1, r2, r3

# ---- the extends ----
sxtb r0, r1
sxth r0, r1
sxtb16 r0, r1
uxtb r0, r1
uxth r0, r1
uxtb16 r0, r1
sxtab r0, r1, r2
sxtah r0, r1, r2
sxtab16 r0, r1, r2
uxtab r0, r1, r2
uxtah r0, r1, r2
uxtab16 r0, r1, r2

# ---- bitfields and bit counting ----
bfc r0, 0, 32
bfc r1, 4, 8
bfi r0, r1, 0, 1
bfi r2, r3, 12, 20
sbfx r0, r1, 0, 32
sbfx r2, r3, 7, 9

rbit r0, r1
rev r0, r1
rev16 r0, r1

# ---- the halfword and dual multiplies ----
smlabb r0, r1, r2, r3
smlabt r0, r1, r2, r3

smlatt r0, r1, r2, r3

smladx r0, r1, r2, r3
smlsd r0, r1, r2, r3
smlsdx r0, r1, r2, r3

smmlsr r0, r1, r2, r3
umaal r0, r1, r2, r3
mul r0, r1
mla r0, r1, r2, r3

# ---- the coprocessor instructions ----
mcr p15, 0, r0, c1, c0, 0
mcr p14, 7, r9, c15, c15, 7
mcr2 p10, 3, r1, c2, c3, 4
mrc p15, 0, r0, c1, c0, 0
mrc2 p10, 3, r1, c2, c3, 4
mcrr p1, 2, r3, r4, c5
mcrr2 p1, 2, r3, r4, c5
mrrc p1, 2, r3, r4, c5
mrrc2 p1, 2, r3, r4, c5
cdp p1, 2, c3, c4, c5
cdp p1, 2, c3, c4, c5, 6
cdp2 p1, 2, c3, c4, c5, 6
ldc p1, c2, [r3]
ldc p1, c2, [r3, 8]
ldc p1, c2, [r3, -8]
ldc p1, c2, [r3, 8]!
ldc p1, c2, [r3], 8
ldc p1, c2, [r3], {8}
ldcl p1, c2, [r3]
ldc2 p1, c2, [r3, 1020]
ldc2l p1, c2, [r3, -1020]
stc p1, c2, [r3]
stcl p1, c2, [r3, 4]!
stc2 p1, c2, [r3], -4
stc2l p1, c2, [r3], {255}

stmia r0, {r1, r2}^
ldmfd sp!, {r0, pc}^

# ============ the floating-point unit and NEON ============
#
# GNU as runs with `-mfpu=neon-vfpv4`; see run.sh.
